why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate is flat at -0.05%, and the related click metrics barely moved: CTR +0.31%, Long Click Rate -0.08%, Reformulation Rate -0.09%.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Queries per User rose 1.9% but it is a secondary, and success did not rise with it, so it shows no gain in result quality.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts are in the scorecard, so which queries the new ranker changes is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison of Successful Search Rate showing the arms already differed would make the test unreadable.
A segment where the new ranker lifts Successful Search Rate by 0.50% or more would justify a narrower follow-up test.
A rerun with a larger sample that finds a lift of 0.50% or more would reopen the question.
